conditions.evidence: IQSEC2 Mutant Mice Displaying Autistic-like Behavior
conditions.label: autistic-like behavior

modalities.evidence: structural and resting state fMRI data acquired from awake head-fixed mice
followed by a single high-resolution structural imaging scan under anesthesia

output.population: A350V IQSEC2 mutant mice and wild-type littermates
output.summary: Structural and resting-state functional MRI from awake head-fixed mice, comparing A350V IQSEC2 mutant mice with wild-type littermates to examine brain-wide alterations linked to autistic-like behavior.
